map.不代表。本工具只覆盖饮食与尿液 pH 这几个可控因素，未纳入尿钙/尿枸橼酸/尿酸: Not exactly. This tool only covers a few controllable factors such as diet and urine pH; it does not include urinary calcium, citrate or uric acid excretion, measured urine volume, anatomical abnormalities, family history, parathyroid function and other clinical indicators. The score is for trend observation in dietary self-management and cannot replace 24-hour urine stone-risk analysis or imaging follow-up.
map.不同结晶的溶解度对 pH 的依赖相反：尿酸在酸性尿中溶解度最低（pH 5.0 时: Different crystals show opposite pH dependence: uric acid is least soluble in acidic urine (almost insoluble at pH 5.0, roughly 10 times more soluble at pH 6.5), so acidic urine adds points. Calcium phosphate and infection-related (struvite) stones behave the other way round, since alkaline urine promotes precipitation, so pH > 7.0 adds points. Calcium oxalate stones are relatively pH-insensitive; the main deduction points are water intake, sodium and oxalate.
map.体检发现尿常规 pH 偏酸或偏碱、既往有结石史者，按结石类型录入尿液 pH、每日: For people whose routine urine pH is acidic or alkaline, or who have a history of stones, enter urine pH, daily water intake and protein/sodium/oxalate intake by stone type to quantify the recurrence risk at the dietary level.
map.同为尿结石，为什么 pH 的评分方向随结石类型变化？: For urinary stones in general, why does the scoring direction of pH change with the stone type?
map.对比同一患者在不同饮食方案下的评分构成，识别权重最高的可控因素（通常是饮水量与钠: Compare the score composition of the same patient under different diet plans to identify the controllable factor with the heaviest weight (usually water intake and sodium intake).

map.：总分 20 分，五项相加：①尿液 pH（按结石类型分支）——尿酸结石 pH<5: : a total of 20 points, summing five items. 1) Urine pH (branching by stone type): for uric acid stones pH<5.5 scores 5, <6.0 scores 3, <6.5 scores 1; for calcium oxalate stones pH<5.5 scores 3 and pH>7.0 scores 2; for calcium phosphate stones pH>7.0 scores 4 and >6.5 scores 2; for infection stones pH>7.0 scores 3, otherwise 1. 2) Water intake (mL/day): <1000 scores 5, <1500 scores 3, <2000 scores 1. 3) Protein (g/kg/day): >1.5 scores 3, >1.2 scores 1. 4) Sodium (mg/day): >4000 scores 3, >3000 scores 2, >2300 scores 1. 5) Oxalate (mg/day): >250 scores 3, >180 scores 2, >150 scores 1. Grades: <=3 low risk, <=8 medium, <=14 high, >14 very high.
map.：默认参数（草酸钙结石，pH 6.0、饮水 1500 mL、蛋白 1.2 g/k: : default parameters (calcium oxalate stones, pH 6.0, water 1500 mL, protein 1.2 g/kg, sodium 3000 mg, oxalate 150 mg) give pH 0 + water 1 + protein 0 + sodium 1 + oxalate 0 = 2 points, graded low risk. The tool flags "insufficient water intake (over 2000 mL/day recommended)" and "high sodium intake increases urinary calcium excretion". By contrast, the high-risk scenario (uric acid stones, pH 5.2, water 800 mL, protein 1.8 g/kg, sodium 4500 mg, oxalate 300 mg) gives 5 + 5 + 3 + 3 + 3 = 19 points, graded very high risk, with advice to alkalinise the urine to pH 6.5-7.0, limit sodium to under 2300 mg/day and reduce protein to 0.8-1.0 g/kg/day.
